scope: Sealed Linux x64 MutexI32/AtomicI32 scopes composed with real structured threads; not general synchronization, retained registration, Suspend or product acceptance
binding: Author identified retained Rust harnesses from final exact3a7 production/tests. Reviewer copied and independently hash-checked both, then replayed them to regenerate and execute the native programs. Runtime-read C failure observer matched exact3a7 bytes before and after execution. No independent Cargo rebuild.
static_review: Checked actual native stable cell layout, source/Types closure preparation, both independent kernel signatures, thread input/capture root admission, call-wide closure consumption and cleanup.

Reviewer-reported worker predicate broadening was corrected: raw ReadAddress requires actual shared i32; ReborrowAddress must preserve exact pointee and permission. Retained malformed raw controls exercise both cases.

Mutex initialization failure cleans the owned closure once without body invocation or destroying an uninitialized mutex. Success retains the cell through nested thread joins, then drops remaining body responsibility and destroys the mutex.

LLVM atomics use actual process-wide atomic instructions; default source order is SeqCst, raw illegal load/store orders reject, and arithmetic fetch_add wraps without a checked failure while holding the mutex.

observed.source_native: Four retained ZIL sources, Clang/API O0/O2:16 successful configurations, actual parent/worker contention25000+25000 updates, fallback absent.
observed.native_faults: Four backend/optimization builds,20 executions: success IBLUDX; init failure ID/exit2; lock, unlock and destroy failures terminate with SIGABRT at the asserted event boundary. C provides observation/failure injection only.
observed.raw: Four source negatives reject. Six forged actual TypedModule variants reject in Analyze, raw Verify and decoded-Wire Verify. Valid Wire/Lower succeeds.
observed.machine_adapter: Independent atomic type/order rejection plus four native backend/optimization configurations using a C four-thread contention harness. Adapter evidence is separate from ZIL source evidence.

Rust_goals.safety: Independent raw/Wire rejection, real shared-root checks and actual cleanup/fault paths reproduced for this sealed scope.
Rust_goals.runtime_memory: Real locks/atomics and native contention executed; Rust performance/RSS comparison NotRun.
Rust_goals.expression_maintenance: Independent scope primitives compose with existing thread_scope; full general APIs and whole-library comparison remain pending.
Rust_goals.compile_cost: Exact current Analyze/Verify budgets reproduced; no default increase or Rust compile-speed claim.
Rust_goals.breakthrough: Finite compositional native synchronization capability with independently reproduced failure cleanup.

limits: Linux x86_64 glibc pthread layout only.
General Mutex<T>, Transfer/Share, owning cells, retained registration, real Suspend/SABI, cancellation/no-future/drain/late wakes and native Windows remain separate obligations.
No reviewer full workspace gate or same-semantics Rust product comparison.
